verdict.rationale: Framer's first-party docs say its AI agent generates editable pages, sections, copy and visuals from a prompt, which you can refine in conversation or on the canvas. They also show prompt-driven edits to an existing design: site-wide typography and color changes, a dark-mode switch, layout changes such as a list to a 2x3 grid, responsive adaptation across breakpoints, and drafts built from a reference image or URL. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated mockups match these vendor claims (all evidence is vendor documentation; the community items are about older Framer and animation performance, not AI generation).
